title: कथाको सैद्धान्तिक विमर्श {Theoretical discussion of the story}
nepali: भन्ने र सुन्ने मौखिक पद्धतिबाट प्राचीन समयदेखि मानवसमाजमा प्रचलित बनेको साहित्यको लोकप्रियविधा कथा हो । मानवले आफ्ना स्वकीय अनुभव अरूसमक्ष प्रकट गर्दा कथाको प्रारम्भ भएको अलिखितइतिहास प्रचलित अनि मौखिक परम्पराबद्ध छ । मानवजीवनको उषाप्रहरदेखि प्रयोगमा रहेको कथा प्राचीनग्रन्थहरूमा धर्म, ज्ञान, उपदेश, दृष्टान्त जनाउने अर्थमा प्रयोग भएको छ । समयको कालखण्डमा कथाकोप्रयोग सामाजिक सत्यका विषयस“ग सम्बद्ध बनेर लिपिबद्ध हु“दा १९ औ“ शताब्दीमा आधुनिक कथाकानामबाट परिचित बनेको हो । पश्चिमी साहित्यमा आधुनिक कथा लेख्ने परम्परा स्थापना भएपछि कथाकासैद्धान्तिक उपकरणका बारेमा पनि विमर्श प्रारम्भ गरिएको हो । कथाकारहरूबाट लिखित कथाहरूकोआन्तरिक वस्तुसङ्गठनलाई ध्यानमा राखेर सैद्धान्तिक उपकरणको खोजी भयो । सृजना गरिएको कथासाहित्यलाई केन्द्रमा राखेर यसका बारेमा वस्तु, आयतन, विधि र अन्य उपकरणको पहिचान गर्नथालियो । कथामा निहित रहेका सत्य सैद्धान्तिक मानकबाट परिचित बन्ने अवसर बन्यो । सर्जकले सृजनागरेका रचनावलीलाई ध्यानमा राखेर कथावस्तु, चरित्र, भाषा, शैली, परिवेश, दृष्टिविन्दु र उद्देश्यको खोजीभयो । कथाको सैद्धान्तिक चेतनाबारे प्रचलित मान्यतालाई ध्यानमा राखेर नवीन चेतनाको खोजी गर्नेसिलसिलामा संरचना र रूपविन्यासको दृष्टिकोण निर्माण भयो । कथाको पहिचान गर्न साहित्यशास्त्रमा केकस्ता अभिमत स्थापना भए ? त्यसको खोजी अध्ययनको उद्देश्य हो । अतः आधुनिक कथाका बारेमापरम्परादेखि प्रचलित सैद्धान्तिक पक्षको विमर्श गर्ने अभीष्ट यस लेखमा राखिएको छ । {It is a popular genre of literature that has been prevalent in human society since ancient times through the oral system of saying and listening. The unwritten history of the beginning of the story is prevalent and oral tradition when human beings reveal their own experiences to others. The story that has been used since the dawn of human life has been used in ancient scriptures to express religion, knowledge, teachings and parables. The use of storytelling over a period of time has become familiar with modern storytelling in the 19th century when it was written in connection with the subject of social truth. After the establishment of the tradition of writing modern stories in Western literature, discussions have also started on the theoretical tools of storytelling. Theoretical tools were explored, keeping in mind the internal content of the stories written by the storytellers. By focusing on the created fiction, objects, volumes, methods and other tools were identified. The truth contained in the story became an opportunity to become acquainted with the theoretical standards. Storytelling, character, language, style, setting, point of view and purpose keeping in mind the creations created by the creator. What ideas were formed in literature to identify the story? The purpose of the study is to find out. Therefore, the purpose of this article is to discuss the theoretical aspects of modern storytelling.}
american_english: The story is a popular genre of literature that has been prevalent in human society since ancient times through the oral method of telling and listening. The unwritten history of the origin of the story when human beings expressed their own experiences to others is prevalent and bound to oral tradition. In use since the dawn of human life, the story has been used in ancient texts in the sense of signifying religion, knowledge, moral instruction, and illustration. Over the passage of time, as the use of the story became connected with themes of social truth and was committed to writing, it came to be known by the name of the modern story in the 19th century. After the tradition of writing the modern story was established in Western literature, discussion regarding the theoretical devices of the story was also initiated. Bearing in mind the internal organization of content in stories written by storytellers, a search for theoretical devices was conducted. Keeping created fiction literature at the center, the identification of its subject matter, scope, method, and other devices began. An opportunity arose for the truths inherent in the story to become recognized through theoretical standards. Bearing in mind the body of works created by authors, an exploration was made of plot, character, language, style, setting, point of view, and purpose. Keeping in mind prevailing assumptions regarding the theoretical consciousness of the story, in the course of seeking a new consciousness, a perspective on structure and formal design was formed. What kinds of opinions were established in poetics to identify the story? Exploring that is the objective of the study. Therefore, the intention to discuss the theoretical aspects concerning the modern story that have been prevalent from tradition is set forth in this article.

informal_english: The story is a popular genre of literature that's been around in human society since ancient times through the oral tradition of telling and listening. The unwritten history of how the story kicked off when human beings shared their own experiences with others is well known and tied to oral tradition. In use since the dawn of human life, the story has been used in ancient texts to convey religion, knowledge, moral guidance, and parables. Over the passage of time, as the use of the story became linked with everyday social truths and was written down, it came to be known as the modern short story in the 19th century. After the tradition of writing modern stories got established in Western literature, discussion regarding the theoretical tools of storytelling was kicked off as well. Keeping the internal organization of content in stories written by storytellers in mind, people started looking into theoretical tools. Putting created story literature front and center, people began identifying its subject matter, scope, method, and other mechanics. An opportunity opened up for the truths sitting inside the story to become recognized through theoretical yardsticks. Keeping the works produced by authors in mind, folks began exploring plot, character, language, style, setting, point of view, and purpose. Keeping prevailing views about the theoretical consciousness of the story in mind, while looking for a fresh perspective, a viewpoint on structure and formal design was shaped. What kinds of views were established in poetics to identify the story? Getting to the bottom of that is the whole point of this study. So, the intention to unpack the theoretical aspects of the modern story that have been around from tradition is set out in this paper.
